prompt:
Bob and Bill are always happy to spend time together and to be seen together. One day in the park, Bob sees Bill walking in his direction. Bob quietly waves at Bill, but Bill doesn't notice. Bob immediately remembers a fact about Bill and then feels very silly.

Given only this context, give your best guess as to what Bob might have remembered.
response: Bob might have remembered that Bill once told him he was allergic to peanuts, and then felt silly because he had just eaten a peanut butter sandwich.
